text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE (1794412000) continuous-batcher: p95/p99 latency spike + container crashes in us-east-1. Auto-paging oncall.

Priya (oncall): I'm on it — seeing big batch growth and repeated OOMs. Posting first-pass notes here.

Sam H: seeing lots of `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` in runtime sidecar logs. Containers restarting with SIGKILL.

Anya R: metrics: within ~90s batch_size tail jumped from ~32 to >900, queue length exploded. kubelet started evicting pods -> node flaps and paging. Affected AZ: us-east-1-b.

Mike L: customer impact: 12 customers with elevated latency, spikes in 5xxs. Acme-inc reported a 5m window of failures. No sign of data exfiltration. Support, flag the top customers.

Support Bot: Notifying customers: acme-inc, foobar-labs, appgen. Posting templated update to their channels.

Priya (oncall): mitigation plan (fast): 1) enable backpressure on continuous-batcher 2) reduce MAX_BATCH_BYTES 3) cordon & rotate hottest nodes 4) rollout restart batcher with bounded config. Doing steps in that order.

Jess K: applying kustomize overlay now and will restart pods rolling. Commands I'm running:

```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/continuous-batcher MAX_BATCH_BYTES=262144 BACKPRESSURE=true
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/continuous-batcher
```

Priya (oncall): holding canary traffic during restart. Watchers, ping if you see regressions.

Daniel (eng-runtime): grabbing logs/cores. Early sign: `kv cache miss` + `batcher.append()` path didn't enforce queue cap when partial-cancel occurs. NVidia driver logs show memory warnings before OOM.

Sam H: grepping runtime logs shows repeating pattern: `allocate` -> `out of memory` -> `OOM killed process 1234 (continuous-batcher)`. Kernel dmesg indicates memory pressure and OOM kills.

Anya R: cordoned node-17 and drained it. Rotated out 2 nodes with highest memory churn. Restarted batcher on node-20 first (lighter load). Seeing p95 begin to fall.

Priya (oncall): quick rollback of last heuristic: `batching.heuristic_v2=false` via feature flag was flipped. That seems to stop the runaway growth immediately. Rolling restarts continuing.

Mike L: customer impact quick summary for incident triage: ~12 customers affected, peak 20% error rate on impacted routes, median time-to-mitigate ~7 minutes after page, full stabilization ~18 minutes due to node rotates. No data leakage. We'll include numbers in postmortem.

Jess K: opening hotfix PR to add strict queue cap assertions and observability. Also adding a histogram for batch_size and a cgroup memory alarm in the autoscaler. Assigning to Daniel + Sam for code fix.

Priya (oncall): handing to eng-runtime for root cause investigation and permanent fix. Handoff notes: logs and cores uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1794412000/, nodes rotated, feature flag toggled, customers notified.

Daniel (eng-runtime): taking ownership for RCA. I'll open an incident ticket, assign P1, and track until fix merged.

incidents-bot: Status update: mitigated -> monitoring. If no regressions in 1h we'll close the page.

Support Bot: customer follow-ups posted. :thumbsup:

Priya (oncall): after-action items: add enforced overflow-drop when queue cap reached, add conservative default MAX_BATCH_BYTES, and add runbook step for fast node rotation on paging.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 1794412567.
